scope: Controlled offline fixtures; measurements grant no production authority or validation shortcut.

methodology.identity_workload: Distinct task, pending, binding, completion, run, artifact, job, report and archive identities. Model, selected REQ-1 goal and output target are shared.
methodology.state_history: Sequential mode queues one new task through an intervening serial increment. Backlog mode queues all tasks initially and each retained before-state equals its predecessor after-state.
methodology.fixture_validation: Every binding receives schema/identity validation; each complete seeded ledger receives full normal validation before measurement. Setup is excluded.
methodology.cache_conditions: Warm OS and SQLite caches after fixture validation; isolated hash and quick_check passes follow validation.
methodology.component_relationships: Timers are inclusive: completion_history includes payload_semantics/proof_load_decode; payload_semantics includes model_load, state_schema_decode, binding_schema, archive_unpack and observation_rederivation. Do not sum nested fields.
methodology.group_comparisons: Analytical active pending identity count times all binding row count implied by the current group-scanning algorithm; not an instrumented timing counter.
methodology.hash_interpretation: Actually reads and SHA256-hashes stored binding, intent, before/after, model, admitted-state, admission, report, archive and receipt bytes. It performs no semantic or authority validation.
methodology.timing_interpretation: Diagnostic elapsed timings without timing thresholds. Repetitions are retained, and stable tests assert identity/state continuity, work counts and corruption rejection.
